customization.philosophyQuote: I believe it's the little details that make a gift truly special. A name, a memory, a personal touch, something that shows how much you know and care about someone. That's what inspires me to create pieces that are as unique as the people they're made for.

sections.title: The Nicoletta Difference
sections.subtitle: Handmade with Love
sections.step1Title: Made With Care, Made For You
sections.step1Desc: We create personalized gifts and custom pieces for the moments you want to remember. Whether it’s a birthday, wedding, anniversary, new home, or just a little something for someone special, we help turn your ideas into meaningful keepsakes.
sections.step2Desc: A name, a date, a special message, or a unique design can turn an everyday item into something unforgettable. We create custom pieces with your story in mind, using engraving and personalized details on wood, glass, acrylic, leather, and more.
sections.step3Title: Have Something In Mind? Let’s Create It
sections.step3Desc: Whether you know exactly what you want or need a little inspiration, we’re here to help bring your idea to life. Every piece is made with care and created to make someone smile.

sections.title: Nicoletta Decor
sections.subtitle: Meet the Craftsman
sections.description: Founded in Portland, Oregon in 2021 by artisan Nicoletta, our shop was born out of a deep reverence for organic materials and classic design. We select local, sustainably-cut timber and cure each board by hand.
sections.extraText1: Every laser brand and sandblast carving is executed one-by-one with surgical attention to grain and texture. We never treat your project as generic manufacture; we create future heirlooms destined to outlast us all.

sections.title: Connect with Nicoletta
sections.subtitle: We'd Love to Hear from You
sections.description: Have a question, a custom request, or a special gift in mind? We'd love to help you create something meaningful. Send us a message and let's make your idea a reality!
